title: Fix Add Piece Tooltip and Type Model Linking
description: Fix the add piece tooltip in sketchpad workbench to show "Add Piece" instead of the full action ID. Also ensure added pieces use the correct linked type models in both diagram and scene windows instead of default spheres.
summary: Fixed two issues in the sketchpad workbench: 1) Added i18n translation entries (EN+DE) for workbench action IDs at compose.sketchpad.app.design.panel.workbench so tooltips show human-readable labels like Add Piece and Duplicate Type instead of raw action ID strings. 2) Added id_ field to pieces created via workbench + buttons for consistency with the drag-drop creation path. All 134 tests pass.
